title: SDF multi-record inspection and explicit conformer grouping

required_steps.description: Reuse the T02 current-candidate SMILES 3D/MMFF94 result without relabeling its GUI evidence
Inspect and convert the fixed mixed-properties SDF; retain all records, properties and missing masks
Review the suggested same-molecule group, atom mappings and ambiguity warning before confirmation
Explicitly confirm molecule.group_conformers and retain independent source records
Export the accepted ConformerSet to SDF, reimport it and reject a different-molecule negative case
Create and render a View, save/move/cold-reopen the pair and exercise recovery

inputs.role: three same-water records with stable source order and deliberately incomplete property columns
T02 applicability anchor; do not rerun or relabel historical GUI events

note: T02 owns SMILES three-dimensionalization and MMFF94 optimization; T03 reuses only its hash-linked current applicability. Standard SDF grouping, negative, cancellation and export/reimport checks passed. Prepare GUI, Blender render/lifecycle, tutorial package and independent human review remain blocked or not run.
